browser.scope: Representative single-browser flows; not a cross-browser, real-patient, simultaneous cross-tab or quota benchmark.
browser.finalSmoke: Supported source preview, malformed Patient URI rejection, and exact reviewed restore/export rechecked after final backup URI/audit gate tightening.

limits: Unencrypted local dataset scopes, not access control or patient matching
One exact absolute FHIR Patient identity per notebook; cross-import aliases and reviewed legacy transfer are pending
Stale-view guards do not provide atomic cross-tab transactions
No user medical or genome data, model inference or paid services used
